scope: Public bibliographic and repository metadata only. No article full text, supplementary file, measurement table, affinity value, structure file, FORT label, .env credential, or model API may be read.
eligibility_rule: A candidate is countable only when metadata explicitly supplies a verified accepted open license and an explicit post-firewall scaffold-diverse query-ligand count of at least 40. Title wording, abstract snippets, total file count, total compound count, citation count, and inferred scaffold diversity do not satisfy the count rule.
deduplication_rule: Collapse records by normalized DOI, then by source-specific persistent identifier. Do not infer provenance links from numerical measurements.
